weapons.description: Immense man-cutting saw of the bandit lord Zagis. Inflicts Pain on enemies.

weapons.name: Great Runic Blade
weapons.description: Summoned magical sword that lasts for a limited amount of time. Acts as a Lexicon when held.

weapons.name: Ice-Flame Torch
weapons.description: Alchemical torch that cools the wielder even in sweltering temperatures. Provides light when held in off-hand.

weapons.name: Makeshift Torch
weapons.description: Torch that shines weakly, held in the off hand. It burns out quickly, but warms up the wielder.
